HSBC cuts global equities outlook from ‘max overweight’ to neutral The bank’s revised stance reflects growing uncertainty over geopolitical developments and the potential regulatory impact on artificial intelligence ahead of US elections By  Reuters Updated - October 26, 2026  at 03:58 PM. × Share WhatsApp X Facebook LinkedIn Messenger Reddit Mail https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/hsbc-cuts-global-equities-outlook-from-max-overweight-to-neutral/article71626430.ece Copy HSBC has downgraded its stance on global equities to neutral, citing Middle East geopolitical concerns and potential AI regulation. HSBC ​on Monday ‌downgraded its stance
on ​global ⁠equities to "neutral" from "max overweight", ‌citing
renewed geopolitical ‌concerns around ‌the ⁠Middle ⁠East and
concerns over potential ​AI ‌regulation ahead of the US mid-term
elections. "The ‌bearish AI ​narratives will be ⁠hard to overcome ‌in the
coming weeks – but there'll be eventual ‌support, in ​our view,"
